title: Measure the copy each panel surface declares and where it declares none
question: which sentences does each panel surface declare for itself, at which path:line, which does it render from a literal nobody keeps in a map, and which surface declares none at all?
head: 21e5d5544f120580dfe5dd7ea7f3d9f83a280376
measuredAt: static: all twenty-six apps/angular-ai-devtools/src/app/panel-*.ts surfaces (the two *.spec.ts files are named in `excluded`) were read line by line at the head above, every non-comment line carrying a string literal was extracted with a throwaway script that prints `file:line|trimmed line` (kept in the session scratchpad and not checked in), and every citation below was re-read from the file when this record was re-measured. No browser was opened, no page was read, no build and no test of the app was run; the only commands executed against these files were that extraction and the verify suite named in `verify`, which re-reads all of them. T001 wrote this record over the nineteen surfaces that existed at cfdff389; T004 re-read every line over the twentieth, panel-copy-check.ts, at b428f068 and repaired the three citations in panel-demo.ts that the M048 T003 commit moved. At 72d6f7de T004 re-read every line again over the twenty-first surface, panel-interaction-story.ts, and repaired the three panel-demo.ts citations the M049 T003 commit moved a second time. At 173166b3 T004 re-read every line again over the twenty-second surface, panel-dead-click.ts, and repaired the same three panel-demo.ts citations the M050 T003 commit moved a third time. At this head T003 re-read every line again over the twenty-third surface, panel-what-changed.ts, and repaired the same three panel-demo.ts citations the M051 T003 commit moved a fourth time. At 2ece0b80 T004 re-read every line again over the twenty-fourth surface, panel-webmcp.ts, and repaired the three panel-demo.ts citations and the one panel-demo.spec.ts citation the M052 T003 commit moved a fifth time. At 0e0eba55 T004 re-read every line again over the twenty-fifth surface, panel-webmcp-rehearsal.ts, and repaired the citations the M053 T003 commit moved. At this head T004 re-read every line again over the twenty-sixth surface, `panel-visual-qa.ts`, added its five registry sentences, its two side-label constants and its fourteen labels, and re-resolved every citation of every surface by searching the file for the line it quotes, so a number that had moved was repaired by search rather than by a typed value. This record was last measured at the head above; the previous head was 0e0eba55d22cc1a9a639dd03c777b374f3400a56.
lineTextConvention: every `lineText` is the cited line with its leading and trailing whitespace trimmed and nothing else removed, so a line that is a bare string literal carries its quotes and its trailing comma. `line` is 1-indexed. The suite re-reads each cited line and requires it to equal `lineText` exactly and to contain the sentence the record quotes.
scope: Recorded per surface: (a) every sentence it declares in a map or a module constant, with the key it is declared under; (b) every sentence — fixed or interpolated — written inside a function body or a component template instead of being declared; (c) the label prefix of every line the surface builds from a label and a value, because that prefix is copy the surface writes; (d) the multi-word prose fragment a surface substitutes for a value it does not have.

Not enumerated as entries: single-token value words a surface derives into a line (`true`/`false` in panel-navigation.ts:186, `disabled`/`unknown` in panel-fields.ts:232 and :235, `valid`/`invalid` in panel-fields.ts:142). They are named in the surface’s own `notes`, and they are values of a line rather than sentences.

Not recorded at all: the `Error` messages `sentenceText` throws for an id the registry does not carry (panel-components.ts:170, panel-console.ts:268, panel-copy-to-agent.ts:159, panel-copy-check.ts:151, panel-dead-click.ts:225, panel-what-changed.ts:177). They are developer-facing throws and are never rendered to a reader.
